title: core security: move the pure federated organization-scope reading (externalOrganizationScopeOf) out of plugin-security, so a service reads it without loading the plugin
body:
domain:server#7 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYm8sWjp2Pk76warN7w

Filing gate: ④ a follow-up named by a contract review, nit N1 of the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` record on PR #32339 (comment 6779604367, card #32062 slice 2). ⛔ Not a claim.
Business reason: sync-in's pull (`@objectstack/service-automation`) now depends on `@objectstack/plugin-security` at run time only to call one pure function and read one string constant. That puts the whole security plugin package in every process that loads the automation service, while everything the reading composes already lives below the plugin.
Reader: triage first touch; the change lands in `packages/core` (security module) and `packages/plugins/plugin-security`.

## Where (`origin/main`; re-read before editing)

- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/external-organization-scope.ts`: `externalOrganizationScopeOf` (a pure reading of a federated object's organization scope) and `EXTERNAL_SCOPE_REMEDY`. re-check: `git grep -n "export function externalOrganizationScopeOf" origin/main -- packages/plugins/plugin-security/src` (control: `EXTERNAL_SCOPE_REMEDY` in the same file).
- What it composes already sits below the plugin: `isFederatedObject` in `@objectstack/core`, `isTenancyDisabled` in `@objectstack/spec`, `TENANT_SCOPE_FIELD_DEF` in `@objectstack/metadata-core`. `packages/core/src/security/tenant-layer0-verdict.ts` already takes its answer as an input (review N1).
- Consumers: the plugin's own boot refusal and Layer 0 input, and (after PR #32339 lands) `packages/services/service-automation/src/datasource-pull.ts`.

## Expected

The pure reading and its remedy constant live in `@objectstack/core`'s security module, and `plugin-security` re-exports them, so its public surface is unchanged. Every consumer imports from core. `@objectstack/service-automation` drops its run-time dependency on `@objectstack/plugin-security`. There is one implementation (the file's own rule: the boot refusal and the Layer 0 input must not re-derive the question), and its behaviour is unchanged and pinned.

Order: after PR #32339 merges, so the third consumer exists to move.

Dedupe (open and closed), run 2026-11-10 21:25 UTC: `externalOrganizationScopeOf` (1 hit: #32062, the card whose PR introduced the dependency). None on point.
